[=Section Roles=]

[| [*Section*] | [*What belongs there*] |]
[| [.txt|00_start_here/.] | repo shape, file layout, primary entry points, and supporting projects |]
[| [.txt|10_language/.] | surface-language forms and how they map into backend-facing concepts |]
[| [.txt|20_pipeline/.] | how `.SPO` and `.ILT` meet at [.txt|mIL_AST.tModule.] |]

[=Core Anchors In Code=]

- [<../SPO_CS/src/mSPO_Interpreter.cs|mSPO_Interpreter.cs>]
  compact end-to-end SPO entry point
- [<../SPO_CS/src/mSPO2IL.cs|mSPO2IL.cs>]
  lowering from annotated SPO AST to IL
- [<../SPO_CS/src/mIL_GenerateOpcodes.cs|mIL_GenerateOpcodes.cs>]
  IL to VM procedure generation
- [<../SPO_CS/src/mVM.cs|mVM.cs>]
  register-based execution
- [<../SPO_CS/src/mModule.cs|mModule.cs>]
  file-based module loading and `.SPO` versus `.ILT` checking
- [<../SPO_CS/src/mRunTests.cs|mRunTests.cs>]
  CLI test host and filter behavior

[=Boundary Rules=]

- if a fact has a date, count, command output, or pass/fail status, keep it under [.txt|40_verification/.]
- keep syntax-reminder material in [.txt|doc/.] unless the page is explaining backend meaning or source ownership
- keep index pages focused on routing readers to the owning leaf page instead of restating whole sections
